canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sort object keys by Unicode code point, arrays keep order, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false, trailing LF

credentials.api_key: optional non-empty string; used only in process memory
credentials.api_key_env: optional environment variable name; compatibility fallback
credentials.receipt_policy: record neither api_key nor its value; record only redacted provider identity

llm.max_input_chars_semantics: count Python len(prompt) Unicode code points; request and receipt record input_chars and input_length_unit=unicode_code_points

failure: missing credential, parse error, unknown field, type/limit/const mismatch or calibration mismatch blocks before the first provider request
